notes.content:

Also big shout out to Dollppin! A fan who lead the charge to get the game translated!

notes.title: Update #1 - Dont call This a Necro - April 17,2017
notes.content:
It's been a while. Its fair to say that enough time has passed in order to disentangle the complex emotions that accompany any personal project.

Consider this a new leaf. An attempt to give this project some of the attention it deserves.


[h1] Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Game-pad button customization. (However, only available  for character movement. Keyboard only for navigating menus)
    [*]In game screen shots (on success and fail screen).
    [*]Full Screen enabled (press ESC to close) .
    [*]Tutorial Screens.
[/list]


[h1] Balancing[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Reduced Boss Monster base HP from 50 to 25.
    [*]Damaged applied to rings after armour calculation.
    [*]Hero will no longer be able to drop Shard when hit.
[/list]

[h1] Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Optimized code to reduce lag spikes. The game should perform better now.
    [*]Reduced opacity of smoke from torches (This should address a few UI issues).
    [*]Charms should no longer spawn inside shrines.
[/list]

[h1]Note: This patch is only applicable to the English Build at this time.[/h1]


[h1] Coming Soon[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Revival of Weekly Challenges.
    [*]Steam Trading Cards. (awaiting approval)
[/list]
